# AHB Insurance Solutions

> Expert independent insurance brokerage in Florida specializing in Medicare Supplement & Advantage, Final Expense Burial Insurance, and Indexed Universal Life (IUL) policies for individuals and families aged 50 and older.

AHB Insurance Solutions is led by licensed independent insurance broker Andres H. Bozo (NPN 21228432), representing over 80 A-rated insurance carriers across Florida to deliver tailored, unbiased coverage options with zero service fees and 100% bilingual support in English and Spanish.

## Core Products & Services

- [Medicare Supplement & Advantage Insurance](/medicare-florida): Complete guide to Medicare Parts A, B, C, and D in Florida, comparing Medigap Plan G, Plan N, and Medicare Advantage network coverage without referrals.
- [Final Expense & Burial Insurance](/final-expense): Guaranteed-acceptance whole life burial policies offering frozen premiums and $5,000–$35,000 cash benefits to cover funeral expenses in Florida.
- [Indexed Universal Life (IUL)](/iul-retirement): Tax-free wealth accumulation and permanent life insurance with a 0% guaranteed market loss floor linked to index growth for retirement planning.
- [Annuities & Guaranteed Income](/annuities-florida): Fixed and indexed annuities designed to protect retirement savings and guarantee lifetime income streams for pre-retirees.
- [Senior Dental, Vision & Hearing](/dental-vision-florida): Supplemental dental and vision plans specifically curated for Medicare beneficiaries in Florida.
